_comment: Variant of split_clips.json that ADDS the rotor_diluted clip to training, to test
whether 29 more instances from a brighter, larger-bubble regime help or hurt.
The RotFine test clip is swapped from '..._inline' to '..._1440rpm' because the
dilute clip IS '..._inline_6dilute' -- the diluted version of that same inline
stream. Training on one while testing on the other is the closest-related pair in
the set and would leak. '..._inline' moves into training.
Fixed before any result was seen, so the change is not result-driven.
